title: Giants DC Dennard Wilson: We love being home underdogs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants DC Dennard Wilson: We love being home underdogs
sources.description: The Giants are 3-1-1 heading into Sunday's home game against a 1-4 Saints team that was excoriated by their owner this week, but oddsmakers don't view the Giants as heavy favorites to win that game.
